title: Understanding LASSO Regularization
text: LASSO regularization adds a penalty equal to the absolute value of the magnitude of coefficients. This can lead to some coefficients being exactly zero, effectively removing some features from the model.

title: Effect on Model Bias
text: When you apply LASSO regularization, the model tends to become simpler by reducing the number of features. How do you think this simplification affects the bias of the model?

title: Possible Effects on (Model Bias)**2
text: Consider how reducing the number of features might affect the model's ability to capture the underlying data patterns. What happens to the bias?
